The Best cross-chain swap
Best Route Swap
PLEXUS analyzes the massive liquidity data through Theta algorithm, divides the liquidity into the optimal route, and proceeds with cross-chain swaps.
Innovative UX
Based on Cross-Chain Routing Protocol (CCRP) technology, PLEXUS enables on-chain exchange of all mainnet tokens with only one click (one transaction).
Fee Solution
PLEXUS supports the ability to pay gas fees for all networks, users can swap between cross-chains without holding a separate gas fee token in their wallet.
Security
Safe cross-chain swap can be
performed by applying CCPR, a
decentralized cross-chain
communication technology.
All chains & all tokens in
one API
PLEXUS' Middleware collects all the liquidity data
from the vast blockchain ecosystem and
makes it easy to use.
PLEXUS collects all the liquidity of
DEXs, Bridges, and DEX aggregators and
provides them in one API through the Theta algorithm.
Join PLEXUS API
The world first cross-chain Vault
PLEXUS offers cross-chain Vault capabilities for the first time in the world PLEXUS not only collects all the liquidity data that exists on the on-chain and provides it as a single UI, but also provides a convenient function to multiply assets in the liquidity in the heterogeneous chainin just one click to do the staking.
